name: hud_layout_hw_update_all
description: HudLayoutHW::UpdateAll conditionally blits the scaled sensor rectangle to the primary surface in replicated video modes before updating the base HUD container.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this ftable slot is deferred to the HUD layout class/source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x413500 shows the blit only when the HUD manager is enabled, replicate mode is not disabled, and the objective phase is zero, then HudUiContainer::UpdateAll is called with the delta time.

The native smoke verifies the disabled, objective-active, replicate-disabled, and active blit paths, including the scaled/raw sensor rectangle arguments passed to g_zVideo_pfnBltSwToPrimaryRectDirect.
